title: 5-toubun no Hanayome*
content:
A rough watch, but not for the right reasons.

Quintuplets has been a contended for a 10/10 for a while, but with the recent releases made it hard to accept at face value. This might have been the weakest release it had.

We gotta agree that the series is past its prime by now, as soon as a girl won, there was no need for showing any more stuff that happens past that point. It’s the best when it flashes backwards to so point in the past when all girls still had a chance, but after when the movie left off, it’s kind of pointless.

These two episodes pick up right where the movie left, the honeymoon. It focuses on a more mature quints that evidently appear to not have matured all that much, showing you tidbits of their goofs and bickers on the honeymoon, which is less of an epilogue and more of a desperate attempt at a cash grab.

Oh, and if you want to listen to some hardcore, unfiltered Engurishu, have a go at this.
Overall: 7.02/10.
